coverage.note: Ratings are fitted on completed UCL matches only. A club with no UCL history falls back to a league-average prior; a club with fewer than 6 matches has a rating, but one shrunk heavily toward average. confidence='rated' means both sides have 6+ matches; 'partial' means at least one side is thin; 'none' means both are unrated and the numbers are the fallback constant — do not present those as predictions.
